BL-1051 — A Let's Talk reply does not commit to the language it was asked in: only the French prefix names a reply language, neither forbids switching mid-reply, and a mangled French transcript silently falls to English
What it solves: Source intake:
`.swarmforge/operator/INTAKE-lets-talk-match-reply-language-to-input.md`
(human via a Let's Talk voice session, 2026-07-29 — the human explicitly
asked for it to be filed as an intake, not carried as chat memory; archived
to `.swarmforge/operator/archive/` on drain).
Approval context: ONE design call needs your answer; the rest of the ticket is settled.
Your two asks pull against each other at the edges. "Per turn, not per session" says every turn is judged on its own. "Do not silently lock to English after a bad turn" says a badly transcribed turn must not flip you into English…
BL-1051 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1051" (or "reject BL-1051 <reason>") to act.
